chunks: And indeed, when the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was distressed, Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام instructed him to wash his head with sidr, and that sidr was from Sidrat al-Muntahā.

key_terms.بِالسِّدْرِ: with sidr, i.e. lote tree leaves used for washing
key_terms.رَسُولَ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.سِدْرَةِ الْمُنْتَهَى: Sidrat al-Muntahā, the lote tree at the utmost boundary

ai.seo_question: What did Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام instruct the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله to do when he was distressed?
ai.summary: This report states that when the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله experienced distress, Jibrāʾīl عليه السلام directed him to wash his head with sidr. It also describes this sidr as being from Sidrat al-Muntahā, giving the event a special sacred association.
